summary: Iteration 2 backend tests: 6/7 passed (mini-audit test assertion false-positive on legitimate calendly https link in lien_rdv — audit itself is clean: no /100, no SEO/HTTPS/SSL/viewport/balise/CMS, ✅/⚠️ format, persisted on prospect, includes calendly link). Frontend: Pipeline page (4 stat cards + 6 kanban cols + draggable cards) renders correctly; Prospects export button present and triggers popup; Scenarios canal=email shows objet input; Parametres has sendgrid + email_expediteur inputs and shows lien_rdv=https://calendly.com/sitequivend/30min. CRITICAL bug: ProspectSheet crashes (Uncaught ReferenceError: generateMiniAudit is not defined) the moment any prospect is opened, blocking mini-audit UI, AI improve from sheet, and all sheet actions.

minor.issue: Functional and clean output; assertion in test mistakenly flagged the legitimate calendly URL (lien_rdv) which contains 'https'. Audit text contains no /100, no SEO/SSL/viewport/balise/CMS jargon — feature is correct.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: generateMiniAudit is not defined at ProspectSheet.jsx (onClick of btn-generate-mini-audit). Function is missing — only state hooks (auditLoading, miniAudit, auditWaLink) are declared. Opening ANY prospect (Pipeline card click, File du jour btn-view-prospect, Prospects table row) triggers red runtime error overlay and the Sheet body never renders.

integration_issues.issue: HTML5 dragstart/drop via dispatch_event did not move card (a_contacter stayed at 11, repondu stayed at 0). dataTransfer payload isn't populated by synthetic events — manual user dragging likely works (handlers set/get text/plain correctly), but cannot be reliably automated without a real native drag. Recommend Playwright page.drag_and_drop with real coords + mouse moves; if still failing, consider exposing a fallback non-DnD action (e.g. status dropdown on card or context menu).

integration_issues.flow: btn-email-send visibility on File du jour
integration_issues.issue: Could not verify in this run because the active queue items use whatsapp canal (no email step active after scenario restore). Recommend setting one prospect's profil to a scenario whose step 1 canal=email to validate the mailto fallback toast without a SendGrid key.

issues: Persistent a11y warnings still present from iteration 1: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Wrap title with VisuallyHidden or add aria-describedby.

action_items: CRITICAL: Define generateMiniAudit function in ProspectSheet.jsx (mirror improveAI pattern): const generateMiniAudit = async () => { setAuditLoading(true); try { const res = await api.post('/ai/mini-audit', { prospect_id: prospectId }); setMiniAudit(res.data.mini_audit); setAuditWaLink(res.data.wa_link); toast.success('Mini-audit généré'); } catch { toast.error('Erreur IA — réessayez'); } finally { setAuditLoading(false); } };
Add a11y DialogTitle/Description (VisuallyHidden wrapper) to Sheet/Dialog components to clear persistent warnings.
Verify btn-email-send visibility/mailto-fallback by configuring a scenario step with canal=email on an active prospect.
critical_code_review_comments: ProspectSheet.jsx onClick references undefined function — should have been caught by ESLint no-undef rule; run lint before commit.
Pipeline.jsx drag&drop has no a11y fallback (keyboard / status selector). Consider adding a button-based status changer on each kanban card.
Settings model accepts sendgrid_api_key but read_settings returns it in clear text — consider redacting when GET (currently low risk as no auth).
/api/ai/mini-audit has no rate limit and persists raw LLM output to DB — add max length cap (already prompted but not enforced server-side).

success_rate.backend: 100% functional (6/7 pytest pass; the 7th is a test-assertion false-positive on calendly URL, feature works)
success_rate.frontend: ~70% — Pipeline/Prospects/Scenarios/Parametres OK; ProspectSheet entirely broken by missing generateMiniAudit fn which blocks any in-sheet workflow (mini-audit, AI improve, mark-sent inside sheet)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. test_iteration2 creates one TEST_simon_*@example.com email_expediteur briefly and restores; modifies pas_de_site scenario briefly and restores.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent defines generateMiniAudit in /app/frontend/src/components/ProspectSheet.jsx, retest: (1) open prospect sheet from Pipeline kanban card AND from File du jour btn-view-prospect → no red overlay, sheet body renders; (2) click btn-generate-mini-audit → after ~15-30s mini-audit-text appears with Copier + btn-mini-audit-whatsapp buttons; (3) verify mini-audit text has no /100, no SEO/HTTPS/SSL/viewport jargon. Do NOT re-run TestMiniAudit (real AI cost — already validated this iteration). Backend iteration_2 features (scenario-stats, export xlsx, email/send fallback, scenario email channel + objet, settings sendgrid persistence) all confirmed working — no retest needed.
rca of the issue: ProspectSheet.jsx (line 221) binds onClick={generateMiniAudit} but no const generateMiniAudit = ... declaration exists in the component. React renders the JSX during reconciliation, evaluates the identifier in the component closure scope, and throws ReferenceError. The error propagates as Uncaught (no error boundary) → react-error-overlay shows the red screen. Fix: add async generateMiniAudit handler that posts to /api/ai/mini-audit and sets state.
